overview: Eli Lilly grew Q2 2026 revenue 48%, with MOUNJARO and ZEPBOUND at $14.9B and non-GAAP EPS of $8.38 after $3.03 of acquired IPR&D charges. Lucas Montarce, CFO, raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $85B-$87B, and the call centred on the Foundayo launch, the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge and retatrutide's BLA pathway.
keyTakeaways: Ilya Yuffa, President of Lilly USA, said Foundayo volume nearly doubled versus a month earlier, about one in four new starts is on it, and prescribers rose to 36,000 from 8,000.
Yuffa said the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge, launched July 1, expands obesity coverage by about 35%, with an estimated 60%-70% of its patients new to therapy.
Dave Ricks, Chair and CEO, said retatrutide is expected to be submitted as a BLA by Q1 2027, pending more CMC data and active litigation over its classification.
Montarce said U.S. ZEPBOUND net price will fall as CVS access from Q4 reduces medical exceptions, which is embedded in guidance.
financialHighlights: Revenue rose 48%, with U.S. revenue up 33% on volume and U.S. price down 3%, or 9% excluding favorable rebate estimate changes.
Gross margin rose about 1.3 points to 86.3%, and the non-GAAP performance margin rose 9 points to 54.8%.
Marketing, selling and administrative expenses rose 25% and R&D rose 14%.
Constant-currency revenue grew 55% in Europe (including a $250M Jardiance milestone), 30% in Japan and 93% in China.
guidance: Lucas Montarce, CFO, raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $85B-$87B and the non-GAAP performance margin to 49%-50.5%.
Montarce set non-GAAP EPS guidance at $35.50-$36.50, a $2.78 midpoint increase before absorbing $3.03 of Q2 IPR&D charges.
Montarce said H2 growth slows because favorable rebate adjustments should not recur and 2025 included a MOUNJARO new-country launch bolus.
Dave Ricks, Chair and CEO, expects Foundayo's U.S. Type 2 diabetes regulatory action later this year, with major international launches at the start of 2027.

qa.question: Why has the U.S. Foundayo launch been slower than anticipated, and how is Lilly faring against Novo's oral pill abroad?
qa.responderTitle: President of Lilly USA and Global Customer Capabilities
qa.answer: Yuffa said late-July volume nearly doubled versus a month earlier with about one in four new starts on Foundayo after CVS, Bridge and full DTC; Patrik Jonsson, President of Lilly International, said Lilly's combined UAE incretin share held steady and early data reflects inventory build.
qa.read: Answered directly; pushed back on the slow-launch premise.

qa.question: Why does guidance imply H2 revenue deceleration despite Bridge and Foundayo access?
qa.answer: Montarce said the guide rose $2.5B, prior-period rebate adjustments should not continue, the 2025 MOUNJARO launch bolus will not recur, and European Q3 and U.S. diabetes Q4 seasonality are built in.

qa.question: How sustainable is ZEPBOUND's ~$580 net price per prescription as CVS returns to formulary?
qa.answer: Montarce cited LillyDirect at $299-$449 and Bridge at $245, said CVS access from Q4 will reduce medical exceptions, and expects lower price, embedded in guidance, to be more than offset by volume.
qa.read: Answered partially; rebate adjustment link not addressed.

qa.question: What is needed for retatrutide to be accepted as a BLA?
qa.answer: Ricks said all clinical data is in hand but more CMC data is needed, the first court decision was mixed, and submission is expected by Q1 next year.

unanswered.question: Whether Foundayo sampling is dampening IQVIA prescription data.
unanswered.how: Ilya Yuffa, President of Lilly USA, described the 30-day sampling program and prescriber growth without addressing the data effect.

unanswered.question: Whether psychiatry and vaccines are scalable priorities or one-off deals.
unanswered.how: Jake Van Naarden, President of Lilly Oncology, declined to look forward and said Lilly will be opportunistic.

unanswered.question: The size of the ex-U.S. Foundayo obesity opportunity given analyst-cited UAE sales of $31M.
unanswered.how: Patrik Jonsson, President of Lilly International, called the data early and noisy and gave no sizing.
